---
title: "The National Guidelines for Open Science "
date: today
---


## Learning Outcomes

Upon completion of this module, students will be able to:

- Summarize the National Guidelines for Open Science and how they will be implemented across stakeholders over the coming years  
- Identify the support Kungliga Biblioteket offers researchers with regards to Open Science and FAIR

## Materials & Reuse
